semiconductor_relevance: Medium — The company provides anticorrosion solutions critical for maintaining infrastructure in semiconductor manufacturing environments.
summary: Zhejiang Baitong Anticorrosion Equipment Co., Ltd. specializes in designing and manufacturing anticorrosion products such as valves, pipes, and storage tanks made from materials like PVDF and PFA. These products are essential for protecting semiconductor manufacturing facilities from corrosive environments, ensuring operational reliability and longevity.
capabilities: All-plastic PVDF and PFA valves and pipes
Storage tanks and towers for corrosive environments
